query: I'm evaluating a 70‑year‑old female. Among female ICU patients 65–75 with pulmonary embolism, stratify first ICU‑stay diagnostic procedure counts within 72 hours into quartiles and report N, mean procedure count, mean ICU LOS (days), and hospital mortality (%) per quartile.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dob) AS age, i.icustay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.procedure_id) AS procedure_count, AVG(i.length_of_stay) AS avg_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortality_count FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON i.hadm_id = d.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dob) BETWEEN 65 AND 75 AND d.icd_code = '440.0' AND d.icd_version = '2015' AND i.intime <= '2015-07-01' AND (i.outtime >= '2015-07-01' OR i.outtime IS NULL) AND (d.chartdate <= '2015-07-01' OR d.chartdate IS NULL) AND (d.itemid <= '440.0' OR d.itemid IS NULL) GROUP BY p.gender, age, i.icustay_id, i.hadm_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.procedure_id) > 0 ORDER BY procedure_count DESC, avg_length_of_stay DESC, mortality_count DESC;
